profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer, Identity & Platform | OAuth 2.1, OIDC, SAML, MCP authorization | 10+ years making SaaS products enterprise-ready
profile.summary:
I make SaaS products enterprise-ready. That has mostly meant identity: SAML single sign-on in 2016, MCP authorization in 2026, and most of the federated identity stack in between.

I've gone from a shared authentication component to a no-code product for automating business processes, then to the platform other products build on, and now to working across product teams rather than inside one.

Agent authorization is mostly an identity problem, and I did not expect a decade of SAML and OAuth work to land me right in the middle of it. Most of what I do is less fashionable than that: authorization models, migration paths, the proxy everything else sits behind. I think about what a system will cost to own three years from now, not just what it takes to ship. The change I'm most pleased with replaced a service with a configuration file.

I've been teaching engineers since 2015, when I taught Rich Internet Applications as an adjunct at UVU. It has stayed a habit rather than a title, and most of it happens in design and code review. Experience level has never been a good predictor of who I learn from. I develop in the open, report issues, and send patches upstream to the tools I depend on.

positions.title: Adjunct Instructor
positions.description: In some spare time, I teach a class called Rich Internet Applications, where I teach students modern web development techniques, practices, and tooling.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Design and architect microservices used to support a variety of teams in their day to day work, including customer management/progression, credit services, and document generation and storage.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Optimize web pages for organic lead generation.

positions.title: Creative Software Developer
positions.description: I develop creative solutions for clients. I use the technologies that will best solve the problem, whether it be Drupal, NodeJS, WordPress, you name it. I focus on web development.

positions.title: Projectionist/Supervisor
positions.description: I used and maintained modern digital entertainment equipment. I was heavily involved in audio/visual equipment setups, including hooking up computers to projectors, computer audio to the house audio systems, et cetera. I also supervised and trained a team of ushers to help make the guests' experience at the theater the best they've ever had.
